description: Compares the fully loaded yearly cost of a US hire (base salary × 1.3 for taxes, benefits and overhead) with the Hire Overseas ballpark for the same role, and returns the yearly savings range and percentage. Without a salary it uses a typical US salary for the role. A ballpark, not a quote: Hire Overseas works within the client's budget and confirms the exact rate on a short call (bookACall).

region.description: Where the hire would be based: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America) or africa. Omit for any region.

role.description: Job title or a few words about the role, e.g. 'Executive Assistant' or 'SDR for a SaaS startup'

seniority.description: Experience level: junior (about 0-2 years), mid (3-5) or senior (6+). Omit if unknown.

us_salary_usd.description: Yearly US base salary the client would otherwise pay, in USD, e.g. 65000. Omit to use a typical US salary for the role.

name: savings_estimate
title: Estimate savings versus a US hire
